component.name: GameGlass Hub
component.summary: Immersive touch experiences for the games you love

description.p: GameGlass Hub is the desktop companion for GameGlass. It connects your phone or tablet with your PC, and turns them into touch-screen controllers for your games and apps. Download controls made by the community, or create your own from a huge range of components. Easily add labels and actions to create immersive and intuitive new ways to play.

ul.li: Connect a phone or tablet to your PC over your local network and use it as a live control surface
Browse and install ready-made control panels
Build your own control panels, with a no-code, drag & drop editor and tons of buttons, switches, and other components
Send keystrokes, macros and virtual gamepad input to any game or app running on the PC
Display game and PC system telemetry

screenshot.caption: The Hub dashboard with news and featured content
Browsing the library of customized control panels
Browse published and pre-designed control panels
Plugins feed game telemetry and system data to your control panels
An editor allows you to create and edit touch-screen controls
Add a wide range of components, buttons, panels, decorations, dials and sliders to your panel
Add input, sound and state actions to your components
